Time how fast support replies

When a channel stops mid-match, the speed of the reply is what you remember. Before you commit to any provider, send a question during your trial and see how long the answer takes and whether it actually helps. MOJO 4K answers on WhatsApp and Telegram, day and night, and can walk you through setup on your device step by step.

What MOJO 4K offers

  • Prices in pounds: £7 for one month or £39 for a year on one screen, up to 5 screens on bigger plans.
  • One-off payments with no auto-renewal and no contract.
  • A 7-day money-back guarantee on every plan (see the refund policy).

  • Support on WhatsApp and Telegram, day and night.
  • A free trial so you can test on your own broadband first.

How to switch without missing anything

  1. Ask for a free trial and test it at a busy time, such as a Saturday afternoon.
  2. Keep your current service until the trial convinces you.
  3. Choose a plan on the pricing page and pay in pounds.
  4. Add your new login to your app using our setup guides. Most people are watching again in ten minutes.

A note on names

Hot IPTV is a name or trademark of its owner. MOJO 4K is not affiliated with it, and this page makes no claims about its service. It lists the points worth checking with any provider.

FAQ

Questions people ask

Is MOJO 4K the same as Hot IPTV?

No. MOJO 4K is a separate service and is not connected to Hot IPTV.

Can I try MOJO 4K before I leave Hot IPTV?

Yes. Ask for a free trial and keep your current service until you are happy.

Will my app work with MOJO 4K?

Almost certainly. We give you an Xtream Codes login and an M3U link, which work in IPTV Smarters Pro, TiviMate, IBO Player, Flix IPTV and most other players.
